/bin/bash -lc "cat > /workspace/tmp/check_pvals.R <<'RS'
# Read pvals generated by python and compare phyper/BH
for (f in c('up97','down97','up98','down98','up99','down99')) {
  p <- read.table(file.path('tmp',paste0(f,'_pvals.txt')), header=TRUE)
  cat(f, 'n', nrow(p), 'sig py padj<.05', sum(p"'$py_padj < 0.05), '"'\\n')
  p"'$r_padj <- p.adjust(p$p, method='"'BH')
  cat('r sig',sum(p"'$r_padj < 0.05),'"'max diff',max(abs(p"'$r_padj-p$py_padj)),'"'\\n')
  # compare scipy p to phyper manually
  p"'$r_p <- phyper(p$k-1, p$K, p$N-p$K, p$n, lower.tail=FALSE)
  cat('"'max p diff',max(abs(p"'$r_p-p$p)),'"'\\n')
}
RS"
